tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: zab bdun rgyud zab sgyu 'phrul las: tshe skor phrin las rgyas pa bzhugs:

tshe bdag rgyal ba rigs lngar 'dud: tshe yi phrin las rgyas pa ni: sngon 'gro rjes kyi bya ba rnams: spyi ching ngam ni tshe phrin bzhin: dngos gzhi bskyed rim bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: chos rnams dmigs med mkhar ltar dag: rang bzhin ma bcos chos kyi dbyings: 'gag med lhun grub 'od gsal ba: thugs rje phyogs lhung med par khyab: zung 'jug rgyu yi hūm̐ yig las: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros snod bcud sbyangs: tshur 'dus e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ: e las nam mkha' gru gsum pa: yaṃ las stobs chen rgya gram rlung: ra las khrag chen zlum por 'khyil: suṃ las zhing chen sa gru bzhi: keṃ las rus pa'i ri rab brtsegs: raṃ las bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: dur khrod mchog gi sa gzhi ru: paṃ las padma 'dab stong la: zhing khams bkod pa phun sum tshogs: hūm̐ las rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang: phyag mtshan lnga yi srung ba'i gur: bhrūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas khang: gru bzhi sgo bzhi 'dod snam la: mchod pa'i lha mo bsam yas gnas: shel gser rā ga mar gad dang: ind+ra nī la'i rtsig pa lnga: 'dzam bu chu gser pha gu la: rin chen nor bu'i phra tshom btab: phyag mtshan lnga yi drwa phyed la: dril bu g.yer kha sil sil sgrog: baiḍūrya yi shar bu la: dung gi mchod rten mda' yab mdzes: sgo bzhi ka ba bum pas mtshan: sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan 'phyang: rta bab bang rim brgyad kyi steng: chos 'khor gdugs tog ri dwags mdzes: thog phub bum pa bre yi dbyibs: chos kyi 'khor lo bcu gsum 'khor: rdo rje nor bu'i tog mchog 'bar: gdugs dang ba dan rgyal mtshan dang: rnga yab dar 'phyang kun nas 'phyar: dpag bsam shing dang bdud rtsi'i mtsho: bkra shis bya tshogs skad snyan sgrog: nang du rdo rje'i gdugs 'khor lo: rin chen ka ba rnams kyis btegs: nyams dga' 'od 'bar pho brang nang: khyams dang gru chad rin po che: shar dkar lho ser nub dmar ba: byang ljang dbus mthing 'od zer 'phro:

dbus su padma 'dab brgyad dang: phyogs bzhir padma 'dab bzhi re: lte ba rnams su dbus seng ge: shar du glang chen lhor rta mchog: nub tu rma bya byang mkha' lding: brgyad res btegs pa'i rin chen khri: pañtsa lī kas legs par bkab: dbus kyi shar nub rin chen khri: kun la nyi zla padma gsal: lhag ma pad rkyang re re'i gdan: phyogs bzhi'i 'dab mar padma dang: nyi zla brtsegs shing gru chad dang: bar khyams rnams su pad rkyang re: sgo bzhir nyi ma'i gdan re re: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i bzhugs gnas gyur: bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe ratna bo dhi satwa pañtsa lī ka padma sūrya tsand+ra maṇḍa la bhrūm̐: hūm̐ yig yongs gyur oṃ dkar po: de nyid 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan: a ha nyi zla byang chub sems: gsum ga rjes chags 'od du zhu: sa bon phyag mtshan 'bar ba las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba thams cad mchod: sku yi rigs mchog kun 'dus thim: 'gro ba'i gti mug sgrib pa sbyangs: rnam par snang mdzad sa ru bkod: 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs gyur las: rnam par snang mdzad tshe dpag med: dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: mtshan bzang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang: dpe byad brgyad cus mdzes par spras: dbu skra thor tshugs rin chen brgyan: dar gyi cod pan stod g.yogs gsol: zi ldir smad g.yogs dar 'phyang dang: gar gyi phu dung rnam par mdzes: dbu rgyan snyan cha mgul rgyan dang: se mo do shal gdu bus spras: ska rags rin chen 'od 'bar can: rus pa'i rgyan drug g.yer kha 'khrol: zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i skyil krung bzhugs: phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad pa'i steng: tshe yi bum pa bdud rtsis bkang: 'khor lo 'od zer 'bar bas mtshan: de yi pang du dbyings phyug dkar: bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod la: mdzes shing nu 'bur bha ga rgyas: dril bu tshe bum 'dzin pas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis yab kyi sked la 'khril: cha lugs thams cad yab dang mtshungs: dbu la rigs lnga yab yum bzhugs:

gnas gsum rigs gsum yab dang yum: yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs par: hūm̐ las rdo rje'i lte ba la: zla ba la ni oṃ gyis mtshan: yum gyi mkha' gsang paṃ padma: nyi ma la ni mūṃ gyis mtshan: yab yum dgyes pa chen pos bskul: sa ma ya hūm̐: sa ma ya st+waṃ: ra ho haṃ: rā ga ya mi: a la la ho: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: bo dhi tsitta spha ra ṇa phaṭa: oṃ āḥhūm̐: yab yum mnyam sbyor byang chub sems: rigs lnga yab yum rnam par 'phros: nam mkha'i mtha' la khyab pa las: rgyal ba thams cad dgyes par byas: thams cad rigs lnga'i rnam par byon: 'gro ba rnams kyi dug lnga sbyangs: rigs lnga yab yum sa ru bkod: thams cad ma lus kun 'dus nas: sku yi rigs mchog bdag la thim: rigs bzhi yum gyi mkha' ru zhu: byang chub sems ni phyir spros pas: sa bon phyag mtshan so sor gyur: dbus kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar: kun tu bzang po sku mdog mthing: mnyam gzhag rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: nub tu kun tu bzang mo mthing: mnyam gzhag padma'i skyil krung bzhugs: shar lhor lha yi thub pa dkar: phyag gnyis chos 'chad pi wang 'khrol: lho ru mi yi thub pa ser: phyag gnyis gseg shang par bu bsnams: lho nub yi dwags thub pa dmar: phyag gnyis zas kyi sgrom bu bsnams: nub byang byol song thub pa sngo: phyag gnyis shes rab po ti 'dzin: byang du lha min thub pa ljang: phyag gnyis rdo rje'i go cha bsnams: byang shar dmyal ba'i thub pa nag: phyag gnyis ye shes me chu 'dzin: thams cad chags bral sprul sku'i tshul: chos gos gsum gsol zhabs gnyis bzhengs: shar gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus: mi bskyod rdo rje tshe dpag med: mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: mdzes pa'i tshul 'chang rin chen brgyan: dar gyi na bza' sna tshogs gsol: zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag phyag rgya'i steng: tshe yi bum pa bcud ldan gyi: kha rgyan rdo rje 'od zer 'bar:

de yi pang du mā ma ki: mthing gsal bcu drug lon pa'i tshul: dril bu tshe bum 'dzin pas 'khyud: de'i phyir padma 'dab bzhi la: sa snying dkar po myu gu 'dzin: lā sye dkar mo me long bsnams: byams pa dkar po klu shing 'dzin: puṣpe dkar mo me tog bsnams: g.yon pa rnams kyis tshe bum 'dzin: rin chen dar brgyan sems skyil bzhugs: lho yi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus: rin chen 'byung ldan tshe dpag med: ser gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: mdzes pa'i tshul 'chang rin chen brgyan: dar gyi na bza' sna tshogs gsol: zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag phyag rgya'i steng: tshe yi bum pa bcud ldan gyi: kha rgyan rin chen 'od zer 'bar: de yi pang du sangs rgyas spyan: ser gsal bcu drug lon pa'i tshul: dril bu tshe bum 'dzin pas 'khyud: de'i phyir padma 'dab bzhi la: nam snying ser po po ti 'dzin: mā le ser mo phreng ba bsnams: sgrib sel ser po ral gri 'dzin: dhū pe ser mo spos khang bsnams: g.yon pa rnams kyis tshe bum 'dzin: rin chen rgyan ldan sems skyil bzhugs: nub kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus: snang ba mtha' yas tshe dpag med: dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: mdzes pa'i tshul 'chang rin chen brgyan: dar gyi na bza' sna tshogs gsol: zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag phyag rgya'i steng: tshe yi bum pa bcud ldan gyi: kha rgyan padma 'od zer 'bar: de yi pang du gos dkar mo: dmar gsal bcu drug lon pa'i tshul: dril bu tshe bum 'dzin pas 'khyud: de'i phyir padma 'dab bzhi la: spyan ras gzigs dmar padma 'dzin: gīrti dmar mo pi wang bsnams: kun bzang dmar ljang snye ma 'dzin: ā lo dmar mo mar me bsnams: g.yon pa rnams kyis tshe bum 'dzin: rin chen rgyan ldan sems skyil bzhugs: byang gi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus: don yod grub pa tshe dpag med:

ljang gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: mdzes pa'i tshul 'chang rin chen brgyan: dar gyi na bza' sna tshogs gsol: zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag phyag rgya'i steng: tshe yi bum pa bcud ldan gyi: kha rgyan rgya gram 'od zer 'bar: de yi pang du sgrol ma ni: ljang gsal bcu drug lon pa'i tshul: dril bu tshe bum 'dzin pas 'khyud: de'i phyir padma 'dab bzhi la: phyag rdor ljang gu rdo rje 'dzin: gar ma ljang gu rnga yab bsnams: 'jam dpal ljang skya utpal 'dzin: dri chab ljang gu dung chos 'dzin: g.yon pa rnams kyis tshe bum 'dzin: rin chen rgyan ldan sems skyil bzhugs: de'i phyir gru chad rnam bzhi la: shar lhor dkar mo mgyogs ma dkar: lho nub sngon mo mgyogs ma mthing: nub byang dmar mo mgyogs ma dmar: byang shar ljang mo mgyogs ma ljang: g.yas pas mda' dar rang mdog dang: tshe bum g.yon 'dzin gar thabs mdzad: de'i phyir bar khyams phyogs mtshams la: shar du gdugs kyi lha mo dkar: shar lhor gser nya'i lha mo ser: lho ru bum pa'i lha mo ljang: lho nub dpal be'u'i lha mo ser: nub tu padma'i lha mo dmar: nub byang rgyal mtshan lha mo mthing: byang du sgra dbyangs lha mo dkar: byang shar 'khor lho'i lha mo ser: g.yas pa rnams kyis rtags brgyad dang: g.yon pas tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis gar stabs mdzad: de ltar gtso 'khor thams cad ni: zhi ba'i tshul dgu ldan pa dang: rgyan chas bcu gsum dag gis brgyan: shar sgor pra dzñānta kṛta smug: rdo rje dang ni dung khrag 'dzin: gnod sbyin dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin: lho sgor ya mānta kṛta ser: thod rlon dbyug thogs dung khrag gsol: 'jigs byed ser mo zhags pa 'dzin: nub sgor padmānta kṛta dmar: thod dbyug sbrul dkris dung khrag 'dzin: bdud rtsi dmar mo lcags sgrog bsnams: byang sgor bignānta kṛta ljang: rgya gram dbyug pa thod khrag 'dzin:

gsod byed ljang mo dril bu 'khrol: yab yum thams cad 'khril sbyor rol: dur khrod chas ldan brkyang bskum gyis: me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du bzhugs: gzhan yang dkyil 'khor steng logs su: tshe dbang rig pa 'dzin rnams dang: bde gshegs rgyal ba sprin ltar gtibs: mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs: mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam yas bcas: nam mkha'i khams la khyab pa rnams: ngo bo stong pa chos kyi dbyings: gtso dang 'khor du tha mi dad: rang bzhin gsal ba longs spyod rdzogs: rnam pa ma 'dres so sor gsal: ci snang ye shes rol pa las: dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun gyis grub: ces bsgom dbang bskur byin rlabs sogs: tshe yi phrin las gzhung bzhin bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya ༁ྃ: zab bdun rgyud zab sgyu 'phrul las: tshe sgrub zab mo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so: rigs lnga tshe dpag med la 'dud: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: 'chi med sgrub thabs mtha' yas shes: kun gyi yang dril rigs lnga yi: tshe sgrub zab mo 'di na bkod: sa ma ya: phun sum tshogs lngas gzhi bzung ste: tshogs bsags sbyin btang srog bslu sogs: phyi bshags dge ba gang 'grub 'bad: phyi nang mtshams bcad dkyil 'khor bzhengs: sku rten mtshan dang dpe byad can: rin chen sa la sogs par bzhengs: gsung rten dar ram shog bu la: mu khyud rim pa lnga bskor ba'i: lte bar 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan: rtsibs brgyad snying pos mtshan pa dang: gnyis par rtsibs bzhi phyag mtshan bzhi: hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥrnams kyis mtshan: so so'i sngags bkod gsum pa la: tshe gzungs dang ni spel tshig bri: bzhi par dbyangs gsal rten snying dang: lnga par rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor: khyams la me yi phreng ba bri: tshe yi rdzas byugs dar gyis dril: thugs rten rnam rgyal mchod rten la: ring bsrel tshe gzungs gzhug pa dang: yon tan thod pa mtshan ldan nang: tshe yi skra dang lo legs nas:

dūrba gi wang sindhu ra: lug mur dbang lag ra mo shag: sbrang dang sbyar ba'i ril bus bkang: phrin las tshe yi rten mda' dang: gtso lnga'i bum pa mgyogs ma'i mda': bcud ldan rgyan dang ldan pa sogs: rten rdzas mchod pa'i rdzas rnams bsham: phrin las bskyed rim tshul bzhin bsgom: bzlas pa'i dus su 'di ltar bskyed: bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: phaṭa dza: ye nas dam tshig ye shes dbyer med kyang: glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma bsal ba'i phyir: ye shes dkyil 'khor mdun du bzhugs nas kyang: dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: de nas so sor bskul ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: dbus phyogs chos dbyings ye shes klong yangs nas: rin chen seng khri padma nyi zla'i steng: snang stong dbyer med rnam snang tshe dpag med: dbyings phyug yum mchog bde gshegs yab yum gnyis: mdzes pa'i sku mchog mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar: snyan pa'i gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cur ldan: thugs mchog chos dbyings ye shes kun la khyab: yab yum gnyis su med pa'i skur bsgom ste: rtsa rlung thig le sngags kyi 'phro 'du yis: bde chen chos dbyings ye shes bsgoms lags na: rig 'dzin tshe yi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: chos dbyings ye shes tshe bdag yab yum gnyis: ma gsal bar du yang yang bskyed cing bsgom: ma 'grub bar du dgongs pa mi gtong bas: da lta nyid du rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs: dka' ba med par 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zhes bskul dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du ni: hūm̐ hrī: rnam snang tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka ru: 'khor lo dkar po'i gwa'u'i nang khongs su: oṃ yig dkar po a nṛ hūm̐ gis mtshan: rlung sbyor bde ba'i rkyen gyis oṃ yig bskul: oṃ las oṃ 'phros stong gsum 'jig rten gang: bde gshegs rigs kyi sangs rgyas thams cad mchod: bdag dang 'gro ba'i gti mug sgrib pa sbyangs:

snang ba thams cad rnam par snang mdzad sku: grags pa thams cad oṃ gyi rang sgrar grags: rig pa bde chen chos dbyings ye shes ngang: slar yang sbyor mtshams las ni 'od 'phros pas: snang srid thams cad oṃ gyi rang bzhin gyur: bde gshegs rigs kyi tshe yi dngos grub dang: 'jig rten khams kyi rgyal rigs thams cad kyi: tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang snyan grags stobs: nam mkha'i khams kyi bcud rnams ma lus pa: yi ge oṃ gyi rnam par bsdus nas su: sbyor mtshams nas zhugs lus kyi nang kun khengs: gwa'u'i kha bye snying po oṃ la thim: bkrag mdangs 'phel zhing 'od kyis lus kun khyab: ba spu'i bu ga 'khor los rgyas gdab cing: bde gshegs rigs kyi tshe yi dngos grub thob: rnam snang yab yum nyid dang dbyer med gyur: zhes bsgom rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor bya: khyad par gud byang bzhin du bsgom: skabs su rlung gi rta la drang: skabs su ngag gi bzlas pa ni: oṃ na mo bha ga ba te bai ro tsa na a pa ri mi ta ā yurdzñā na sogs nas swā hā: zhes bzlas skabs su mda' dar g.yab: hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes ngang nyid las: bde stong dbyer med longs spyod rdzogs: rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gnyis: rang rig rang gsal thugs dam bskul: 'dzin med bde chen pho nya spros: gnyis 'dzin 'khor 'das tshe bcud rnams: gnyis med ye shes chen por sdus: rang rig bde chen klong du stims: ma bcos ngang du rgyas thob cig: zhen snang 'chi bdag bdud rnams choms: rnam rtog nad gdon bar chad sol: bde chen ka dag klong yangs su: lus snang rdo rje lha yi sku: rtsa rlung thig le sngags kyi gdangs: dran rtog bde chen thugs kyi dbyings: 'chi med sku gsung thugs 'grub pa'i: phrin las gnyan po'i dus la babs:

zhes bskul dmigs pa yang yang bsgom: mi bskyod yab yum bskul ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: shar phyogs me long ye shes klong yangs nas: rin chen glang po padma nyi zla'i steng: gsal stong dbyer med mi bskyod tshe dpag med: mā ki yum mchog rdo rje yab yum gnyis: mdzes pa'i sku mchog mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar: snyan pa'i gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cur ldan: thugs mchog me long ye shes kun la khyab: yab yum gnyis su med pa'i skur bsgom ste: rtsa rlung thig le sngags kyi 'phro 'du yis: bde chen me long ye shes bsgoms lags na: rig 'dzin tshe yi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: me long ye shes tshe bdag yab yum gnyis: ma gsal bar du yang yang bskyed cing bsgom: ma 'grub bar du dgongs pa mi gtong bas: da lta nyid du rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs: dka' ba med par 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zhes bskul dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du ni: hūm̐ hrī: mi bskyod tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka ru: rdo rje sngon po rgya gram gwa'u'i nang: hūm̐ yig sngon po a nṛ hūm̐ gis mtshan: rlung sbyor bde ba'i rkyen gyis hūm̐ yig bskul: hūm̐ las hūm̐ 'phros stong gsum 'jig rten gang: rdo rje rigs kyi sangs rgyas thams cad mchod: bdag dang 'gro ba'i zhe sdang sgrib pa sbyangs: snang ba thams cad mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku: grags pa thams cad hūm̐ gi rang sgrar grags: rig pa bde chen me long ye shes ngang: slar yang sbyor mtshams las ni 'od 'phros pas: snang srid thams cad hūm̐ gi rang bzhin gyur: rdo rje rigs kyi tshe yi dngos grub dang: 'jig rten khams kyi rje'u rigs thams cad kyi: tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang snyan grags stobs: chu yi khams kyi bcud rnams ma lus pa: yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam par bsdus nas su: sbyor mtshams nas zhugs lus kyi nang kun khengs: gwa'u'i kha bye snying po hūm̐ la thim: bkrag mdangs 'phel zhing 'od kyis lus kun khyab:

ba spu'i bu ga rdo rjes rgyas btab cing: rdo rje rigs kyi tshe yi dngos grub thob: mi bskyod yab yum nyid dang dbyer med gyur: zhes bsgom rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor bya: khyad par gud byang bzhin du bsgom: skabs su rlung gi rta la drang: skabs su ngag gi bzlas pa ni: oṃ na mo bha ga ba te akṣo bhya a pa ri mi ta sogs nas swā hā: zhes bzlas skabs su mda' dar g.yab: hūm̐: me long ye shes ngang nyid las: bde stong dbyer med longs spyod rdzogs: mi bskyod rdo rje yab yum gnyis: rang rig rang gsal thugs dam bskul: 'dzin med bde chen pho nya spros: gnyis 'dzin 'khor 'das tshe bcud rnams: gnyis med ye shes chen por bsdus: rang rig bde chen klong du stims: ma bcos ngang du rgyas thob cig: zhen snang 'chi bdag bdud rnams choms: rnam rtog nad gdon bar chad sol: bde chen ka dag klong yangs su: lus snang rdo rje lha yi sku: rtsa rlung thig le sngags kyi gdangs: dran rtog bde chen thugs kyi dbyings: 'chi med sku gsung thugs 'grub pa'i: phrin las gnyan po'i dus la babs: zhes bskul dmigs pa yang yang bsgom: rin 'byung yab yum bskul ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: lho phyogs mnyam nyid ye shes klong yangs nas: rin chen rta mchog padma nyi zla'i steng: tshor stong dbyer med rin 'byung tshe dpag med: spyan ma yum mchog rin chen yab yum gnyis: mdzes pa'i sku mchog mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar: snyan pa'i gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cur ldan: thugs mchog mnyam nyid ye shes kun la khyab: yab yum gnyis su med pa'i skur bsgom ste: rtsa rlung thig le sngags kyi 'phro 'du yis: bde chen mnyam nyid ye shes bsgoms lags na: rig 'dzin tshe yi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: mnyam nyid ye shes tshe bdag yab yum gnyis: ma gsal bar du yang yang bskyed cing bsgom: ma 'grub bar du dgongs pa mi gtong bas: da lta nyid du rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs:

dka' ba med par 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zhes bskul dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du ni: hūm̐ hrī: rin 'byung tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka ru: rin chen ser po zur brgyad gwa'u'i nang: trāṃ yig ser po a nṛ hūm̐ gis mtshan: rlung sbyor bde ba'i rkyen gyis trāṃ yig bskul: trāṃ las trāṃ 'phros stong gsum 'jig rten gang: rin chen rigs kyi sangs rgyas thams cad mchod: bdag dang 'gro ba'i nga rgyal sgrib pa sbyangs: snang ba thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan sku: grags pa thams cad trāṃ gi rang sgrar grags: rig pa bde chen mnyam nyid ye shes ngang: slar yang sbyor mtshams las ni 'od 'phros pas: snang srid thams cad trāṃ gi rang bzhin gyur: rin chen rigs kyi tshe yi dngos grub dang: 'jig rten khams kyi bram ze thams cad kyi: tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang snyan grags stobs: sa yi khams kyi bcud rnams ma lus pa: yi ge trāṃ gi rnam par bsdus nas su: sbyor mtshams nas zhugs lus kyi nang kun khengs: gwa'u'i kha bye snying po trāṃ la thim: bkrag mdangs 'phel zhing 'od kyis lus kun khyab: ba spu'i bu ga rin chen rgyas btab cing: rin chen rigs kyi tshe yi dngos grub thob: rin 'byung yab yum nyid dang dbyer med gyur: zhes bsgom rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor bya: khyad par gud byang bzhin du bsgom: skabs su rlung gi rta la drang: skabs su ngag gi bzlas pa ni: oṃ na mo bha ga ba te ratna saṃ bha wa a pa ri mi ta sogs nas swā hā: zhes bzlas skabs su mda' dar g.yab: hūm̐: mnyam nyid ye shes ngang nyid las: bde stong dbyer med longs spyod rdzogs: rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum gnyis: rang rig rang gsal thugs dam bskul: 'dzin med bde chen pho nya spros: gnyis 'dzin 'khor 'das tshe bcud rnams: gnyis med ye shes chen por sdus: rang rig bde chen klong du stims: ma bcos ngang du rgyas thob cig:

zhen snang 'chi bdag bdud rnams choms: rnam rtog nad gdon bar chad sol: bde chen ka dag klong yangs su: lus snang rdo rje lha yi sku: rtsa rlung thig le sngags kyi gdangs: dran rtog bde chen thugs kyi dbyings: 'chi med sku gsung thugs 'grub pa'i: phrin las gnyan po'i dus la babs: zhes bskul dmigs pa yang yang bsgom: mtha' yas yab yum bskul ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: nub phyogs sor rtog ye shes klong yangs nas: rin chen rma bya padma nyi zla'i steng: bde stong dbyer med mtha' yas tshe dpag med: gos dkar yum mchog padma yab yum gnyis: mdzes pa'i sku mchog mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar: snyan pa'i gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cur ldan: thugs mchog sor rtog ye shes kun la khyab: yab yum gnyis su med pa'i skur bsgom ste: rtsa rlung thig le sngags kyi 'phro 'du yis: bde chen sor rtog ye shes bsgoms lags na: rig 'dzin tshe yi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: sor rtog ye shes tshe bdag yab yum gnyis: ma gsal bar du yang yang bskyed cing bsgom: ma 'grub bar du dgongs pa mi btang bas: da lta nyid du rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs: dka' ba med par 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zhes bskul dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du ni: hūm̐ hrī: mtha' yas tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka ru: padma dkar po 'dab brgyad gwa'u'i nang: hrīḥyig dmar po a nṛ hūm̐ gis mtshan: rlung sbyor bde ba'i rkyen gyis hrīḥyig bskul: hrīḥlas hrīḥ'aphros stong gsum 'jig rten gang: padma rigs kyi sangs rgyas thams cad mchod: bdag dang 'gro ba'i 'dod chags sgrib pa sbyangs: snang ba thams cad mtha' yas yab yum sku: grags pa thams cad hrīḥyi rang sgrar grags: rig pa bde chen sor rtog ye shes ngang: slar yang sbyor mtshams las ni 'od 'phros pas: snang srid thams cad hrīḥyi rang bzhin gyur: padma rigs kyi tshe yi dngos grub dang: 'jig rten khams kyi dmangs rigs thams cad kyi:

tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang snyan grags stobs: me yi khams kyi bcud rnams ma lus pa: yi ge hrīḥyi rnam par bsdus nas su: sbyor mtshams nas zhugs lus kyi nang kun khengs: gwa'u'i kha bye snying po hrīḥl thim: bkrag mdangs 'phel zhing 'od kyis lus kun khyab: ba spu'i bu ga padmas rgyas btab cing: padma rigs kyi tshe yi dngos grub thob: mtha' yas yab yum nyid dang dbyer med gyur: ces bsgom rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor bya: khyad par gud byang bzhin du bsgom: skabs su rlung gi rta la drang: skabs su ngag gi bzlas pa ni: oṃ na mo bha ga ba te padma dha ra a pa ri mi ta sogs nas swā hā: zhes bzlas skabs su mda' dar g.yab: hūm̐: sor rtog ye shes ngang nyid las: bde stong dbyer med longs spyod rdzogs: snang ba mtha' yas yab yum gnyis: rang rig rang gsal thugs dam bskul: 'dzin med bde chen pho nya spros: gnyis 'dzin 'khor 'das tshe bcud rnams: gnyis med ye shes chen por sdus: rang rig bde chen klong du stims: ma bcos ngang du rgyas thob cig: zhen snang 'chi bdag bdud rnams choms: rnam rtog nad gdon bar chad sol: bde chen ka dag klong yangs su: lus snang rdo rje lha yi sku: rtsa rlung thig le sngags kyi gdangs: dran rtog bde chen thugs kyi dbyings: gnyis med sku gsung thugs 'grub pa'i: phrin las gnyan po'i dus la babs: zhes bskul dmigs pa yang yang bsgom: don grub yab yum bskul ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: byang phyogs bya grub ye shes klong yangs nas: rin chen mkha' lding padma nyi zla'i steng: dbyings rig dbyer med don grub tshe dpag med: sgrol ma yum mchog las rab yab yum gnyis: mdzes pa'i sku mchog mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar: snyan pa'i gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cur ldan: thugs mchog bya grub ye shes kun la khyab: yab yum gnyis su med pa'i skur bsgom ste: rtsa rlung thig le sngags kyi 'phro 'du yis:

bde chen bya grub ye shes bsgoms lags na: rig 'dzin tshe yi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: bya grub ye shes tshe bdag yab yum gnyis: ma gsal bar du yang yang bskyed cing bsgom: ma 'grub bar du dgongs pa mi gtong bas: da lta nyid du rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs: dka' ba med par 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zhes bskul dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du ni: hūm̐ hrī: don grub tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka ru: rdo rje ljang gu rgya gram gwa'u'i nang: āḥyig ljang gu a nṛ hūm̐ gis mtshan: rlung sbyor bde ba'i rkyen gyis āḥyig bskul: āḥlas āḥ'aphros stong gsum 'jig rten gang: las rab rigs kyi sangs rgyas thams cad mchod: bdag dang 'gro ba'i phrag dog sgrib pa sbyangs: snang ba thams cad don yod grub pa'i sku: grags pa thams cad āḥyi rang sgrar grags: rig pa bde chen bya grub ye shes ngang: slar yang sbyor mtshams las ni 'od 'phros pas: snang srid thams cad āḥyi rang bzhin gyur: las rab rigs kyi tshe yi dngos grub dang: 'jig rten khams kyi gdol ba'i rigs rnams kyi: tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor snyan grags stobs: rlung gi khams kyi bcud rnams ma lus pa: yi ge āḥyi rnam par bsdus nas su: sbyor mtshams nas zhugs lus kyi nang kun khengs: gwa'u'i kha bye snying po āḥl thim: bkrags mdangs 'phel zhing 'od kyis lus kun khyab: ba spu'i bu ga rgya gram rgyas btab cing: las rab rigs kyi tshe yi dngos grub thob: don grub yab yum nyid dang dbyer med gyur: ces bsgom rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor bya: khyad par gud byang bzhin du bsgom: skabs su rlung gi rta la drang: skabs su ngag gi bzlas pa ni: oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a mo gha siddhi a pa ri sogs nas swā hā: zhes bzlas skabs su mda' dar g.yab: hūm̐: bya grub ye shes ngang nyid las: bde stong dbyer med longs spyod rdzogs: don yod grub pa yab yum gnyis:

rang rig rang gsal thugs dam bskul: 'dzin med bde chen pho nya spros: gnyis 'dzin 'khor 'das tshe bcud rnams: gnyis med ye shes chen por sdus: rang rig bde chen klong du stims: ma bcos ngang du rgyas thob cig: zhen snang 'chi bdag bdud rnams choms: rnam rtog nad gdon bar chad sol: bde chen ka dag klong yangs su: lus snang rdo rje lha yi sku: rtsa rlung thig le sngags kyi gdangs: dran rtog bde chen thugs kyi dbyings: 'chi med sku gsung thugs 'grub pa'i: phrin las gnyan po'i dus la babs: zhes bskul dmigs pa yang yang bsgom: tshe yi rdzas la dmigs nas su: hūm̐ hrī: bhrūm̐ las bhañdza gzhal yas khang pa'i nang: ril bu nyi zla'i gwa 'u rnams kyi nang: tshe yi bdag po rigs lnga yab yum bzhugs: bde chen 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril te: ril bu'i lha tshogs rnams kyi sbyor mtshams la: phog pas des bskul rjes chags 'od zer tshogs: nam mkha'i mthar spros snod bcud ma dag sbyangs: thams cad dag pa bdud rtsi'i ngang du bsgyur: 'khor 'das thams cad byang chub sems su zhu: 'ub kyis ril bu'i lha tshogs sku la 'dus: mnyam sbyor dga' bas 'od zhu bdud rtsi yi: gong bu oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥs mtshan pa: 'od 'bar rab 'phel 'phar g.yo nus par ldan: tshe dpal spel ba'i bdud rtsi chen por gyur: oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri mi ta sogs nas swā hā: mthar oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: mūṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā yurdzñā na tiṣṭha oṃ: zhes bzlas bum pa sgrub pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: rang byung ye shes bum pa gzhal yas khang: tshe bdag rigs lnga yab yum bzhugs pa la: thugs srog sngags phreng gzungs thag la brgyud de: bum lha'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul: sbyor mtshams las ni 'od zer dpag med 'phros: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi tshe bcud ma lus pa: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥyi rnam par bsdus:

bum pa'i nang zhugs tshe yi bdud rtsir zhu: zhes bsgom gzungs thag 'dzin nas su: oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri mi ta sogs nas swā hā: kā ya wā ka tsitta ā yurdzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa ā be sha ya a ā: zhes bzlas tshe 'gugs yang yang bya: thun mtshams mchod cing bstod nas su: rang nyid khrus byas khro bor bsgom: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badzra kro dha dzwa la maṇḍa la phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: ha la ha la hūm̐: zhes bzlas thun brab gu gul bdug: oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: zhes bzlas srung 'khor yang yang bsgom: gsol gdab 'khon bshags rgyud sbyong ni: ho: bla ma tshe dpag med mgon dang: rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: dam tshig nyams chag ma lus bshags: so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi: sdom pa srog phyir mi gtong bzung: mchog dman dge la rjes yi rang: bdag cag smin grol mdzad du gsol: bdag gi mgon du bzhugs nas kyang: sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir: tshe dang ye shes dpag med kyi: go 'phang dus 'dir 'grub par mdzod: dbang dang dngos grub bsdu ba'i phyir: bdag dang 'der 'tshogs rnal 'byor rnams: skad cig padma tshe dpag med: dmar gsal zhal gcig longs spyod rdzogs: phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin: rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs pa'i pang: gsang ba ye shes bcu drug ma: dmar gsal bde ba chen pos 'khril: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan: padma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs: thugs kar padma kha sprod dbus: hrīḥlas 'od 'phros dkyil 'khor pa'i: lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul: sku dang sngags phreng phyag mtshan sogs: char ltar bab nas rang la thim: byin rlabs gzi brjid 'bar bar

bsam: oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri sogs mthar dzñā na ā be sha ya a ā: rol mo bsgrags shing spos kyis bdug: byin chen phebs pa'i rtags byung tshe: tiṣṭha badzra sa brtan par bya: bum pa spyi bor blangs nas su: so so'i dmigs pa kha bsgyur zhing: hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes bum pa ru: bde gshegs rigs kyi lha tshogs bzhugs: tshe bcud 'dus pa'i dbang bskur bas: bdud rtsi bum pa'i kha nas lhud: lus nang gang ste snying ga yi: gwa 'u'i kha bye oṃ la thim: steng 'og 'khor lo kha bsgrigs te: 'khor lo'i lu gu rgyud kyis bcings: sku yi tshe dbang thob par gyur: oṃ na mo bha ga ba te bai ro tsa na a pa ri mi ta sogs mthar kā ya ā yurdzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: me long ye shes bum pa ru: rdo rje rigs kyi lha tshogs bzhugs: tshe bcud 'dus pa'i dbang bskur bas: bdud rtsi bum pa'i kha nas lhud: lus nang gang ste snying ga yi: gwa 'u'i kha bye hūm̐ la thim: steng 'og rdo rje kha bsgrigs te: rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud kyis bcings: thugs kyi tshe dbang thob par gyur: oṃ na mo bha ga ba te akṣo bhya a pa ri mi ta sogs mthar tsitta ā yurdzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: mnyam nyid ye shes bum pa ru: rin chen rigs kyi lha tshogs bzhugs: tshe bcud 'dus pa'i dbang bskur bas: bdud rtsi bum pa'i kha nas lhung: lus nang gang ste snying ga yi: gwa 'u'i kha bye trāṃ la thim: steng 'og rin chen kha bsgrigs te: rin chen lu gu rgyud kyis bcings: yon tan tshe dbang thob par gyur: oṃ na mo bha ga ba te ratna saṃ bha wa a pa ri sogs mthar gu ṇa ā yurdzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ: hūm̐: sor rtog ye shes bum pa ru: padma rigs kyi lha tshogs bzhugs: tshe bcud 'dus pa'i dbang bskur bas: bdud rtsi bum pa'i kha nas lhud: lus nang gang ste snying ga yi: gwa 'u'i kha bye hrīḥl thim: steng 'og padma kha bsgrigs te:

padma'i lu gu rgyud kyis bcings: gsung gi tshe dbang thob par gyur: oṃ na mo bha ga ba te padma dha ra a pa ri mi ta sogs mthar wā ka ā yurdzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: hūm̐: bya grub ye shes bum pa ru: las rab rigs kyi lha tshogs bzhugs: tshe bcud 'dus pa'i dbang bskur bas: bdud rtsi bum pa'i kha nas lhud: lus nang gang ste snying ga yi: gwa'u'i kha bye āḥl thim: steng 'og rgya gram kha bsgrigs te: rgya gram lu gu rgyud kyis bcings: phrin las tshe dbang thob par gyur: oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a mo gha a pa ri mi ta sogs mthar karma ā yurdzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: dam rdzas tshe tshang longs spyod cing: hūm̐ hrī: mi 'gyur tshe la longs spyod phyir: byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin rnams: rdo rje lce yis drangs nas su: snying gar srog gi ngo bor gnas: bde stong ye shes rab 'phel te: bgres rgud med pa'i tshe thob shog: oṃ na mo bha ga ba te a pa ri mi ta sogs mthar na mo ā yurdzñā na tshe bhrūm̐: skabs 'dir zab pa'i tshe bsdu la: gal chen gud byang bzhin du bya: de nas tshe sba rgyas gdab ni: hūm̐ hrī: snying ga'i nyi zla'i gwa 'u rigs lnga po: phyag mtshan lngas mtshan gzhi yi khams lnga dang: dbyer med gdod nas mi 'gyur ngang du gnas: skye 'chi 'pho med ka dag chen por bzhugs: rten 'brel snying po bzla bzhin pas: tshe nas 'thor zhing brtan par bya: tshogs 'khor gtor skyong dkyil 'khor bsdu: mtshams grol smon lam bkra shis dang: gter sba gnas srung ci rigs bya: des ni 'chi med tshe dbang thob: bgres med sku dang rgud med gsung: 'pho med bde chen thugs la sogs: 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'bad med 'byung: de phyir 'di la brtson par gyis: mi 'dzad rin chen gter du sbos: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ༁ྃཿ zab bdun rgyud zab sgyu 'phrul las: tshe skor gso ba gsum ldan bzhugs so: tshe bdag rnams la gus phyag 'tshal:

gso ba gsum ldan gdams pa ni: dang po tshe nyams gso ba ni: phyi bshags la sogs tshul bzhin bya: nus ldan byin rlabs rtsal che ba'i: bla ma dag la mnyes pa bsgrub: tshe yi dbang bskur brgya rtsa zhu: chos skyong bran du khol ba yi: sngags pas bla tshe yang yang bkug: rang nyid tshe yi sgrub pa bzhin: dkyil 'khor rten mchod legs par bsham: tshe yi phrin las rgyas bsdus sogs: bskyed rim sa mā dhi la gnas: phyi nang gsang gsum rtsa rlung thig: 'khrul 'khor rnams kyis tshe spel zhing: thun mtshams rnams su rigs lnga yi: rim par so so'i sku ru bsgom: shar gyi phyogs su kha bltas te: mi bskyod tshe dpag med du bsgom: thugs srog las ni 'od 'phros pas: 'das pa'i rdo rje rigs kyi tshe: 'khor ba'i skye 'gro bram ze'i rigs: dri za me lha la sogs pa'i: tshe dang dbang thang bsod nams dang: kha dog dkar ba'i rin chen sman: glang chen la sogs byol song rigs: 'byung ba chu yi bcud rnams ni: yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam par byas: 'od zer sngon por zhu nas su: 'ub kyis bsdus te rlung dang 'grogs: kha yi nang nas tshur byung ste: lus kyi nang kun gang ba dang: snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam: kha yis hub hub lto bar bskyil: bum pa can gyi sbyor ba brtsam: dbyings rig bsre zhing dal bus btang: skabs su gegs sel ha sprug bya: de bzhin lho ru nub byang dbus bcas 'phrul zhes gsungs/ mchan/ kha bltas te: rin 'byung tshe dpag med du bsgom: dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du sngar bzhin no: de tshe rtags kyi rim pa yang: dngos su tshe lha'i zhal mthong zhing: lus ni 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku: ngag ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang ldan: yid ni lta ba'i gding dang ldan: yon tan tshe la zad pa med: phrin las 'gro ba mtha' yas sgrol: gzhan yang rten las 'od 'phro zhing: bum chu tshe chang bum rdzas khol: mar me 'phel zhing gtor ma la: 'ja' zug bdud rtsi 'bab pa dang:

tshe mda' 'phel zhing sngags sgra thos: rmi lam la yang nyi zla shar: ri rtser 'dzegs dang mchod rten mthong: sātstsha gdab dang 'bru mang rnyed: gos bzang rgyan thogs phreng ba legs: dbyar gyi dus su gyur pa rmis: tshe nyams sos pa'i rtags yin pas: dbang dang dngos grub blang bar bya: gal te de las ldog pa na: spogs pa'i cho ga yang yang bya: de ni tshe nyams gso ba 'o: gnyis pa bsod nams nyams pa dag: gso ba'i thabs ni 'di lta ste: phyi bshags la sogs tshul bzhin bya: stegs bu ba byung lnga yis byugs: gnas khang rgyan gyis legs par brgyan: mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rig mar bcas: thig gdab dkyil 'khor bri ba ni: phrin las rgyas pa bzhin du 'bri: lding khri rim pa gsum bshams la: spos dang rol mor bcas pa yis: sku gsung thugs rten brtsegs mar bzhugs: phyogs bzhi dbus lngar bum pa bsham: rten mda' las bzhi'i mda' dar dang: dam rdzas tshe gal tshe ril bsham: sman raka gtor gsum zhal zas tshogs: snang gsal mar me la sogs pa'i: mchod pa brgya dang rtsa brgyad bsham: ral gri phur pa me long mda': dar sna ba dan rgyal mtshan dang: tshon skud drwa bas dkyil 'khor brgyan: tshe yi phrin las rgyas par btang: de nas bsod nams gsag pa'i phyir: dang po phyi mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: tshe yi lha tshogs tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas pa la: bdag sogs sems can tshogs gnyis gsag pa'i phyir: stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na: yan lag brgyad ldan chu bo thams cad kun: dag pa bdud rtsi yid 'ong khrus kyi chab: rgyal ba'i sku la rnyog pa mi mnga' yang: bdag sogs sems can sgrib gnyis dag pa'i phyir: rgyal ba'i sku la khrus chab 'di gsol bas: lus ngag yid gsum sdig sgrib kun dag nas: bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog: hūm̐ hrī: tshe yi lha tshogs tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas pa la:

bdag sogs sems can bsod nams gsag pa'i phyir: stong gsum 'di 'am stong gsum gzhan dag na: dag byed sman dang dri ldan spos chu'i rigs: yid du 'ong ba nam mkha' khyab par sbreng: rgyal ba'i sku la dri ma mi mnga' yang: bdag sogs sems can sgrib gnyis dag pa'i phyir: rgyal ba'i phyag zhabs ma lus kun bsil bas: nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa kun dag nas: bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog: hūm̐ hrī: tshe yi lha tshogs tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas pa la: bdag sogs sems can bsod nams gsag pa'i phyir: stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na: mdzes pa'i me tog ngo mtshar blta na sdug: rin chen phreng ba rnam pa sna tshogs pa: rgyal ba'i sku la ye shes rgyan mnga' yang: bdag sogs sems can mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar phyir: rin chen me tog phreng bas skur brgyan pas: mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba'i lus thob ste: bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog: hūm̐ hrī: tshe yi lha tshogs tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas pa la: bdag sogs sems can tshogs gnyis gsag pa'i phyir: stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na: lhan skyes dri dang sbyar ba'i dri bzang dri: tshor ba tsam gyis bde ba skyed pa'i sprin: rgyal ba'i sku la sme gtsang mi mnga' yang: bdag sogs sems can mi gtsang sgrib bral phyir: sna tshogs dri bzang bdug spos 'di phul bas: tshul khrims nyams sogs nyams pa kun sangs te: bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog: hūm̐ hrī: tshe yi lha tshogs tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas pa la: bdag sogs sems can tshogs gnyis gsag pa'i phyir: stong gsum 'di 'am stong gsum gzhan dag na: 'bru dang rtsi mar shing bal me dang sbyar: nyi zla la sogs snang gsal ji snyed pa: rgyal ba'i thugs la rmongs pa mi mnga' yang:

bdag sogs sems can ma rig bsal ba'i phyir: rin chen sgron me bzang po 'di phul bas: ye shes snang ba ma lus rab rgyas te: bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog: hūm̐ hrī: tshe yi lha tshogs tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas pa la: bdag sogs sems can bsod nams gsag pa'i phyir: stong gsum 'di 'am stong gsum gzhan dag na: sim pa skyed pa'i sman mchog ji snyed pa: bde ba skyed pa'i chab dang rab sbyar te: bdag sogs sems can nyon mongs sbyong ba'i phyir: rgyal ba'i thugs la dri chab 'di phul bas: byang chub sems kyi bslab pas blo sbyangs te: bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog: hūm̐ hrī: tshe yi lha tshogs tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas pa la: bdag sogs sems can bsod nams gsag pa'i phyir: stong gsum 'di 'am stong gsum gzhan dag na: dkar gsum mngar gsum shing thog sna tshogs dang: 'bru yi rigs sogs zhal zas yongs sbyar rnams: rgyal ba'i sku la bkres pa mi mnga' yang: bdag sogs sems can ser sna'i sgrib sbyong phyir: rgyal ba'i sku la zhal zas 'di phul bas: ting nge 'dzin gyi zas la longs spyod cing: bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog: hūm̐ hrī: tshe yi lha tshogs tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas pa la: bdag sogs sems can bsod nams gsag pa'i phyir: stong gsum 'di 'am stong gsum gzhan dag na: snyan pa'i dbyangs dang 'gyur ba'i glu la sogs: rol mo'i zlos gar bsam gyis mi khyab pa: rgyal rnams gsung dbyangs drug cur rab ldan kyang: sems can mos pa'i chos sgra thos pa'i phyir: rgyal ba rnams la rol mo 'di phul bas: gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu rab thob cing: bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog: mchod pa thogs nas dkyil 'khor bskor: bstod dbyangs rol mo bcas pas 'bul:

de nas nang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: spyi gtsug bde chen bhandha ru: go ro tsa na'i bdud rtsis bkang: 'di ni bdud rtsi sman gyi mchog: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: mgrin pa longs spyod bhandha ru: dmar gsal byang sems bdud rtsis bkang: 'di ni bdud rtsi sman gyi mchog: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: snying ga chos dbyings bhandha ru: byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis bkang: 'di ni bdud rtsi sman gyi mchog: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: lte ba sprul pa'i bhandha ru: ser gsal dri chen bdud rtsis bkang: 'di ni bdud rtsi sman gyi mchog: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: gsang ba bde skyong bhandha ru: dag byed dri chu'i bdud rtsis bkang: 'di ni bdud rtsi sman gyi mchog: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: de nas gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: gti mug bsgral ba'i bhandha ru: chos kyi dbyings kyi raktas bkang: chags med rakta'i mchod pa 'dis: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: 'dod chags bsgral ba'i bhandha ru: sor rtog ye shes raktas bkang: chags med rakta'i mchod pa 'dis: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: zhe sdang bsgral ba'i bhandha ru: me long ye shes raktas bkang: chags med rakta'i mchod pa 'dis: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: nga rgyal bsgral ba'i bhandha ru: mnyam nyid ye shes raktas bkang: chags med rakta'i mchod pa 'dis: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: phrag dog bsgral ba'i bhandha ru: bya grub ye shes raktas bkang: chags med rakta'i mchod pa 'dis: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni: hūm̐: zhing chen pags pa'i gtor gzhong du: sha dang rus pa'i gtor ma bshams: dbang po rnam pa lnga yis brgyan: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: 'khor lo lnga yi gtor gzhong du: bdud rtsi lnga yi gtor ma bshams: don snod lnga yis brgyan pa 'dis: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs=

dwangs gsal rtsa yi gtor gzhong du: ye shes klong lnga'i gtor ma bshams: dkar dmar thig les brgyan pa 'dis: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs= thabs dang shes rab gtor gzhong du: rtsa rlung thig le'i gtor ma bshams: bde ba chen pos brgyan pa 'dis: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs= kun khyab dbyings kyi gtor gzhong du: rang gsal ye shes gtor ma bshams: sna tshogs snang bas brgyan pa 'dis: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: phyi nang gsang gsum kho na nyid: thams cad 'dus pa'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: thabs dang shes rab bhandha ru: dga' ba'i rang bzhin tshogs gtor bshams: rmad du byung ba'i mchod pa 'dis: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: gnyis med mnyam sbyor bhandha ru: mchog gi dga' ba'i tshogs gtor bshams: rmad du byung ba'i mchod pa 'dis: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: dkar dmar 'bab pa'i bhandha ru: khyad par dga' ba'i tshogs gtor bshams: rmad du byung ba'i mchod pa 'dis: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs= byang sems 'dres pa'i bhandha ru: dga' bral ye shes tshogs gtor bshams: rmad du byung ba'i mchod pa 'dis: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: bde ba gyen 'khyil bhandha ru: lug ldog dga' bzhi'i tshogs gtor bshams: rmad du byung ba'i mchod pa 'dis: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang:

mnyam rdzogs ye shes mchod pa ni: hūm̐: phung po lus kyi kong bu ru: rtsa gsum 'khor lo'i sdong bu btsugs: bdud rtsi rnam lnga'i mar khus gtams: ye nas dag pa'i me sbar ba: rmad du byung ba'i snang gsal 'dis: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: yab yum thabs shes kong bu ru: byang chub sems kyi mar khus gtams: rlung gi 'gro 'ong sdong bu btsugs: bde ba chen po'i me sbar ba: rmad du byung ba'i snang gsal 'dis: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: snang ba bde ba'i kong bu ru: mched pa gsal ba'i mar khus gtams: thob pa mi rtog sdong bu btsugs: 'od gsal ye shes me sbar ba: rmad du byung ba'i snang gsal 'dis: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: yul snang stong pa'i kong bu ru: dbang po'i byed las mar khus gtams: rnam shes tshogs brgyad sdong bu btsugs: gnyis med spros bral me sbar ba: rmad du byung ba'i snang gsal 'dis: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: skye ba med pa'i kong bu ru: 'gag pa med pa'i mar khus gtams: 'gro 'ong gnas med sdong bu btsugs: phyi nang zang thal me sbar ba: rmad du byung ba'i snang gsal 'dis: tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: rtse gcig smon lam btab pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: snang ba'i rtsal rdzogs tshe lha'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi: rmad byung mchod pa rgya mtsho 'di phul bas: tshe dbang rig pa 'dzin rnams mnyes gyur cig: tshe lha rgyal ba rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang: 'khor tshogs sprul pa sras bcas rab mnyes te: dam tshig nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rnal 'byor bdag gi nyams chag sor chud nas: tshe dang ye shes dngos grub thob par shog: gnyis pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: chos dbyings ye shes bcom ldan tshe yi bdag: dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis longs spyod rdzogs: tshe yi bum pa bcud ldan 'khor lo bsnams: rnam snang tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod:

mkha' khams rnam dag dkar mo lang tsho can: dril bu tshe bum 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud: bde chen ye shes tshe dbang stsol mdzad ma: yum mchog dbyings phyug ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: me long ye shes bcom ldan tshe yi bdag: mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis longs spyod rdzogs: tshe yi bum pa bcud ldan rdo rje bsnams: mi bskyod tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: chu khams rnam dag mthing gsal lang tsho can: dril bu tshe bum 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud: bde chen ye shes tshe dbang stsol mdzad ma: yum mchog mā ma ki la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: mnyam nyid ye shes bcom ldan tshe yi bdag: ser gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis longs spyod rdzogs: tshe yi bum pa bcud ldan rin chen bsnams: rin 'byung tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: sa khams rnam dag ser mo lang tsho can: dril bu tshe bum 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud: bde chen ye shes tshe dbang stsol mdzad ma: yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: sor rtog ye shes bcom ldan tshe yi bdag: dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis longs spyod rdzogs: tshe yi bum pa bcud ldan padma bsnams: mtha' yas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: me khams rnam dag dmar mo lang tsho can: dril bu tshe bum 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud: bde chen ye shes tshe dbang stsol mdzad ma: yum mchog gos dkar mo la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: bya grub ye shes bcom ldan tshe yi bdag: ljang gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis longs spyod rdzogs: tshe yi bum pa bcud ldan rgya gram bsnams: don grub tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: rlung khams rnam dag yum mchog dam tshig sgrol: dril bu tshe bum 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud: bde chen ye shes tshe dbang stsol mdzad ma: yum mchog dam tshig sgrol mar phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: byed pa rnam dag mthing ga mnyam gzhag can: tshe bdag kun tu bzang por phyag 'tshal bstod:

bya ba rnam dag mthing ga mnyam gzhag can: tshe bdag kun tu bzang mor phyag 'tshal bstod: brtson 'grus tshe la mnga' brnyes lha yi 'jig rten 'dren pa'i pi wang 'dzin: brgya byin dkar po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzod pa'i tshe la mnga' brnyes lha min 'jig rten 'dren pa'i go cha bsnams: thags bzang mthing ga'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshul khrims tshe la mnga' brnyes mi yi 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gseg par bsnams: thub chen gser mdog can la phyag 'tshal bstod: shes rab tshe la mnga' brnyes byol song 'jig rten 'dren pa'i po ti 'dzin: seng rab sngon po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: sbyin pa'i tshe la mnga' brnyes yi dwags 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sgrom bu 'dzin: kha 'bar dmar po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam gtan tshe la mnga' brnyes dmyal ba'i 'jig rten 'dren pa'i me chu bsnams: chos rgyal nag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: rnam shes tshogs brgyad gnas su dag pa yi: tshe bdag sems dpa' brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog dkar po myu gu tshe bum 'dzin: tshe lha sa yi snying por phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog dkar ser klu shing tshe bum 'dzin: tshe lha byams pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog ser po po ti tshe bum 'dzin: tshe lha nam mkha'i snying por phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog dmar ser ral gri tshe bum 'dzin: tshe lha sgrib pa sel la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog dmar po padma tshe bum 'dzin: tshe lha spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog dmar ljang snye ma tshe bum 'dzin: tshe lha kun tu bzang por phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog ljang gu rdo rje tshe bum 'dzin: tshe lha phyag na rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog ljang dkar utpal tshe bum 'dzin: tshe lha 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: yul bzhi dus bzhi gnas su dag pa yi: tshe lha sems ma brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod:

sku mdog dkar mo me long tshe bum 'dzin: tshe lha lā sye ma la tshe 'dzin sgeg pa mo phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog dkar ser me tog tshe bum 'dzin: tshe lha puṣpe ma tshe 'dzin me tog ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog ser mo phreng ba tshe bum 'dzin: tshe lha mā lye ma tshe 'dzin phreng bam la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog dmar ser spos khang tshe bum 'dzin: tshe lha dhū pe ma tshe 'dzin bdug spos ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog dmar mo pi wang tshe bum 'dzin: tshe lha gīrti ma tshe 'dzin glu len ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog dmar ljang snang gsal tshe bum 'dzin: tshe lha ā lo ma tshe 'dzin mar me ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog ljang gu rnga yab tshe bum 'dzin: tshe lha nīrti ma tshe 'dzin gar byed ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog ljang dkar dung chos tshe bum 'dzin: tshe lha gandhe ma tshe 'dzin dri chab ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: gzhan yang ye shes rang rtsal rol pa las: tshe yi sprul 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: dkar mo gdugs dkar dang ni tshe bum 'dzin: tshe bdag gdugs kyi lha mor phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog ljang mo gter dang tshe bum 'dzin: tshe bdag bum pa can la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog dmar mo padma tshe bum 'dzin: tshe bdag padma can la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog dkar mo dung dkar tshe bum 'dzin: tshe bdag dung can ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog mthing ga rgyal mtshan tshe bum 'dzin: tshe bdag rgyal mtshan can la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog ser mo gser nya tshe bum 'dzin: tshe bdag gser nya can la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog ser mo dpal be'u tshe bum 'dzin: tshe bdag dpal be'u can la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog ser mo 'khor lo tshe bum 'dzin: tshe bdag 'khor lo can la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: mda' dar dkar po shel gyi bum pa 'dzin: dkar mo mgyogs ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: mda' dar sngon po baiḍū'i bum pa 'dzin:

sngon mo mgyogs ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: mda' dar dmar po bye ru'i bum pa 'dzin: dmar mo mgyogs ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: mda' dar ljang gu g.yu yi bum pa 'dzin: ljang mo mgyogs ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: mtha' bzhi'i nyon mongs 'joms pa'i khro bo bzhi: smug nag 'bar ba rdo rje dung khrag 'dzin: khro rgyal mi g.yo ba la phyag 'tshal bstod: mthing nag zhing gi dbyug pa thod khrag 'dzin: khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog dmar po thod dbyug thod khrag 'dzin: khro rgyal rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod: ljang nag rgya gram dbyug pa thod khrag 'dzin: khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: tshad med bzhi yi dbyings las skur bzhengs ma: khro bo'i sku la gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: sku mdog dkar mo 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu 'dzin: rdo rje gnod sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog ser mo 'ching byed zhags pa 'dzin: rdo rje 'jigs byed ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog dmar mo sdom byed lcags sgrog 'dzin: rdo rje bdud rtsi ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog ljang mo myos byed dril bu 'dzin: rdo rje gsod byed ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: tshe dang ye shes byin rlabs gter gyi mdzod: rig 'dzin bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshe dang ye shes dngos grub kun gyi bdag: yi dam lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshe yi bar chad thams cad sel bar mdzad: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshe la gnod pa'i bar chad bgegs rnams 'dul: chos skyong srung ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: de ltar rig 'dzin tshe yi lha tshogs la: mchod pa phul cing yon tan dran pa yis: bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthu byin gyis: tshe dang ye shes dngos grub thob par shog:

ces bstod thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: sngon tshe gdod ma'i dbyings kyi zhing khams su: tshe yi bdag po kun tu bzang po dang: tshe yi bdag mo kun tu bzang mo gnyis: spros bral 'gyur med chen po'i sku ru grub: chos sku'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyis: tshe yi rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: rang rig 'pho med rdo rje'i sku 'grub nas: rtag cing khyab pa'i tshe dang ye shes stsol: hūm̐ hrī: 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i pho brang du: bcom ldan mgon po tshe bdag rigs lnga dang: tshe yi lha mo dbyings phyug yum lnga yis: bde chen 'gyur med dbyings su sku brnyes pa'i: longs sku'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyis: tshe yi rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: rang rig 'pho med rdo rje'i sku 'grub nas: rtag cing khyab pa'i tshe dang ye shes stsol: hūm̐ hrī: snang ba rnam dag phyogs bcu'i zhing khams su: thabs kyi cha 'dzin sangs rgyas sras rnams dang: shes rab cha 'dzin sras mo'i tshogs rnams kyis: thugs rje rgyun chad med pa'i sku brnyes pa'i: sprul sku'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyis: tshe yi rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: rang rig 'pho med rdo rje'i sku 'grub nas: rtag cing khyab pa'i tshe dang ye shes stsol: hūm̐ hrī: khyad par nub phyogs bde chen zhing khams su: tshe dang ye shes dpag med bcom ldan 'das: gsang ba ye shes gos dkar yab yum gnyis: skye 'chi bgres rgud med pa'i sku brnyes pa'i: khyed kyi rjes su bdag gis bsgrub lags pas: tshe yi rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: shar phyogs po ṭa la yi zhing khams su: tshe yi bdag po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: gsang ba'i yum mchog padma dbyings phyug gnyis: skye 'chi bgres rgud med pa'i sku brnyes pa'i: khyed kyi rjes su bdag gis bsgrub lags pas: tshe yi rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig:

mdzes shing shes rab snang ba'i zhing khams su: mkhyen rab mnga' bdag 'phags mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs: yum mchog smra ba'i dbang phyug rgyal mo gnyis: skye 'chi bgres rgud med pa'i sku brnyes pa'i: khyed kyi rjes su bdag gis bsgrub lags pas: tshe yi rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: mi 'gyur lcang lo can gyi pho brang du: gsang ba'i bdag po rig 'dzin rdo rje chos: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo las kyi dbang mo gnyis: skye 'chi bgres rgud med pa'i sku brnyes pa'i: khyed kyi rjes su bdag gis bsgrub lags pas: tshe yi rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: gnas mchog a su ra yi brag phug tu: tshe dbang rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas dang: tshe yi phyag rgya mandā ra ba gnyis: skye 'chi bgres rgud med pa'i sku brnyes pa'i: khyed kyi rjes su bdag gis bsgrub lags pas: tshe yi rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: o rgyan sindhu 'o ma'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram: sprul pa'i sku mchog dga' rab rdo rje dang: rnal 'byor dbang mo bde chen rgyal mo gnyis: skye 'chi bgres rgud med pa'i sku brnyes pa'i: khyed kyi rjes su bdag gis bsgrub lags pas: tshe yi rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: rgya gar me tog ri yi nags khrod du: grub pa'i slob dpon hūm̐ chen kā ra dang: bram ze'i bu mo bde ldan sgyu 'phrul gnyis: skye 'chi bgres rgud med pa'i sku brnyes pa'i: khyed kyi rjes su bdag gis bsgrub lags pas: tshe yi rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: rgya gar dri bsung ldan pa'i ri mgul du: mkhas pa paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra: bde chen gter mnga' yum mchog padma can: skye 'chi bgres rgud med pa'i sku brnyes pa'i: khyed kyi rjes su bdag gis bsgrub lags pas: tshe yi rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: sngon dus rig 'dzin tshe yi khungs re bzang:

da lta rig 'dzin tshe yi dpal re 'du: tshe dang ye shes sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: tshe dbang rig 'dzin myur du 'grub par mdzod: de nas tshe yi dbang blang ba: tshe 'brang spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkod: hūm̐ hrī: mi 'gyur tshe 'brang padma rā ga'i mdog: zla gam 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang pa ru: tshe bdag sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bzhugs: ye shes lnga yi rig rtsal cho 'phrul gyis: 'khor 'das khams lnga'i tshe yi bcud bsdus te: snying por 'khyil ba tshe yi dngos grub mchog: lus ngag yid gsum tshe rten srog rten la: gnyis med bstims pas tshe yi dngos grub mchog: skye 'chi bgres rgud med pa'i sku thob shog: oṃ ā yurdzñā na tshe bhrūm̐ hūm̐: tshe chang bdud rtsi ngag tu blud: hūm̐ hrī: gangs ri lhun chags g.yu mtsho gtan 'khyil dang: mtshungs pa'i tshe chang mar gyi gzed kha can: skad cig bhandha thabs shes snod nang du: tshe yi lha tshogs mnyam pa'i ril bu rnams: yab yum dngos su gyur pa bde chen sbyor: byang chub sems kyi 'od zer 'phro 'du yis: 'khor 'das tshe yi bcud rnams thams cad bsdus: thams cad 'od zhu bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'khyil: lce yi rdo rje hūm̐ gis drangs nas su: rtsa khams thams cad bdud rtsi'i dwangs mas khyab: byang sems thig le rab rgyas bde stong 'phel: mi shigs tshe yi dngos grub thob par shog: oṃ ā yurdzñā na tshe bhrūm̐:

tshe rten mar me thugs kar bzung: hūm̐ hrī: thabs shes lus mtshon nyi zla'i gwa 'u ru: rtsa thig rlung gsum sngags kyi mar khus gtams: rang rig 'gyur med sku yi sdong bu la: bde chen ye shes snang gsal me sbar nas: ye shes chen po'i srog tu bzung ba ni: dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa rnams la 'bul: ma rig 'khor ba'i nyon mongs mun pa bsal: thabs shes lus kyi rtsa rlung dwangs ma kun: 'dus pa'i tsitta srog gi gzhal yas su: gwa 'u sngags phreng srog yig bcas pa rnams: mdun gyi lha yi thugs ka nas byung ste: rang gi sems dang gnyis su med par bzhugs: dbyings dang rig pa gnyis su med par bzhag: tshe yi dngos grub kun gyi mthar thug pa: bde chen spros bral lhun gyis grub pa yi: mi 'gyur rtag cing khyab pa'i gding thob shog: oṃ ā yurdzñā na tshe bhrūm̐ hūm̐: de ltar dbang blangs phrin las mjug gi tshogs: rgyas par btang bas bsod nams nyams pa gso: gsum pa las nyams gso ba ni: 'chi nges srog chags brgya stong ngam: lo grangs srog bslu byas pa la: srog chags rnams kyi thod pa ru: mar gyi rdo rje g.yung drung bri: chos nyid dag pa'i sngags kyis sbyang: stong pa'i ngang las ye shes las: grub pa'i srog chags sna tshogs pa: yongs gyur hrīḥyig 'od 'bar ba: mchod pa'i tshogs su gyur nas kyang: tshe yi lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: hūm̐ hrī: tshe yi lha tshogs thams cad la: ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can: rnam pa rin chen sna lnga las: grub pa'i srog chags sna tshogs pa: rin chen mi dang cang shes rta: g.yag lug ra gsum za le 'bri: mkha' lding gcan gzan la sogs pa: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phro: 'dod yon lnga yis rab brgyan te: gus pas 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas tshe dang ye shes kyi: dngos grub ma lus bstsal du gsol: de lta bu yi gdams pa yis: nyams pa gsum po nges par gso: khyad par 'phags pa'i gdams pa'o:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kho bo o rgyan mchog gyur bde chen gling pas nam mkha' mdzod nas spyan drangs/ phyis su gnas mchog tsa 'dra rin chen dpal kun spungs pa padma'i ljags ldan gyi gdan sa chen por gtan la phab rim bzhin du yi ge'i ris byed karma tshe dpal lo// sarba maṅga laṃ// //
